cases.prompt: Redesign a high-frequency incident triage dashboard for expert SREs. It has live alerts, tables, bulk actions, keyboard shortcuts, destructive mute/resolve actions, desktop plus tablet.
must: route information architecture, interaction, state modeling, data-dense, responsive, accessibility, design-system and independent critics
treat live-update stability and destructive scope as material
must_not: route by the word dashboard to generic cards/charts only
load every specialist skill without reasons
prioritize marketing-style aesthetic exploration over incident decisions
cases.oracle: inspect UI_TASK_PROFILE selected_skills/inactive_faculties and reasons; each selected skill must own a material decision or verification risk

cases.prompt: The existing design system is approved. Change one secondary button label from 'Submit' to 'Save changes' and preserve everything else.
must: route interface copy and relevant regression/accessibility state only
cases.oracle: routing profile demonstrates minimality and explicitly justifies omitted design faculties

cases.prompt: Faithfully rebuild an accepted Figma mobile banking transfer screen including error, pending and success states on iOS.
must: route task flow, state modeling, accessibility, platform conventions and fidelity verification
must_not: run free aesthetic exploration that changes target
claim screenshot alone defines transfer semantics
omit platform behavior because Figma looks complete
cases.oracle: router freezes visual axes from target while selecting hidden-behavior and verification faculties

cases.prompt: Audit an existing checkout flow; do not change code yet.
must: route independent UX/accessibility/interaction critics based on observed flow
must_not: silently fix issues while judging them
cases.oracle: audit produces typed findings against current artifact with may_modify false semantics
